description:
User decision 2026-05-13: every crate README has a defined shape and authorship/license goes in Cargo.toml, NEVER in the README.

## Convention (verbatim from user)

A README has:
1. What it is
2. What it's for
3. How to use
4. How it works
5. Any gotchas
6. References to specification

Authorship and license go in the toml file (workspace inheritance via the workspace.package block).

## Scope

All 32 crate-jmap-* directories in this workspace, including testjig (publish = false but README still consumed by humans).

## Initial audit observations

- Every crate has a README.
- Heading text varies: '## What' / '## Why' / '## Usage' vs '## What it is' etc.
- Every README appears to carry a '## License' block — these all need to come out.
- Smaller READMEs (jscalendar-types, jscontact-types, cid-types) are missing 'how it works' and 'gotchas'.
- Larger READMEs (base-client at 594 lines, mail-types at 446 lines) conform to the 6-section shape but include redundant license blocks.

## Phased plan

Phase 1: codify convention in workspace AGENTS.md
Phase 2: parallel audit of all 32 READMEs (one structured finding per crate)
Phase 3: per-family fix (8 types + 7 servers + 8 clients + 2 sub-types + 4 foundation/misc + testjig)
Phase 4: re-run cargo publish --dry-run -p jmap-types to verify packaging still clean

## Acceptance

- Workspace AGENTS.md has a 'README convention' section
- All 32 READMEs use the 6 named headings (or a deliberately documented variant)
- Zero README files contain a '## License', '## Authors', '## Authorship', or 'Licensed under' block
- cargo test --workspace + cargo clippy + cargo publish --dry-run -p jmap-types all still pass

LABELS: docs, publish-readiness, canonical-template-sweep
title: README convention sweep: codify 6-section shape and conform all 32 crate READMEs
